entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Hong Kong Adventist Hospital – Stubbs Road is one of two Seventh-day Adventist hospitals in Hong Kong, the other being Hong Kong Adventist Hospital – Tsuen Wan. It is a private hospital, and is located on Stubbs Road, on Hong Kong Island. It provides a wide range of medical services.
